label: Pedestrian in truck path
description: A person on foot walks into the travel path of a moving forklift, which stops abruptly to avoid collision.
evidence: Frame 1: Person walking near forklift. Frame 2: Person closer to forklift. Frame 3: Forklift begins to stop. Frame 4: Forklift stopped, person still in path.
rationale: A pedestrian is seen walking directly in the forklift's forward path, and the forklift is observed moving and then stopping abruptly, indicating the person was in imminent danger of being struck.
standard: 29 CFR 1910.178(n)(1) - operator shall slow or stop for pedestrians

label: Pedestrian in truck path
description: A person walks into the path of a moving forklift. The individual is on foot, and the forklift is in motion, with the person positioned in the truck's direction of travel.
evidence: Frame 1: Forklift stationary, person not visible. Frame 2: Forklift begins moving, person starts walking. Frame 3: Person is closer to the forklift, now in its path. The person is approximately one truck-length ahead of the forklift in Frame 3.
rationale: Frames 2 and 3 show a person on foot walking into the path of a moving forklift, positioned within one truck length ahead, meeting the pedestrian_in_path criteria.
standard: 29 CFR 1910.178(n)(1) - operator shall slow or stop for pedestrians
